newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures close lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures close lower across the board.

text.p: June 4 - IMM currency futures closed a lackluster session. Activity consisted mostly of spreading, as traders rolled positions into Sept from June. EMU uncertainties pressured contracts. However, losses were limited ahead of Fri's US labor data. Ford's U.S. May auto sales fell three pct in May. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
